mechanism: Replace continuous raw-zero dwell with a bounded stop latch. Enter only after three distinct, model-accepted front/rear pairs spanning at least 0.20 s, each wheel below 0.02 m/s and pre-correction model speed below 0.10 m/s. Hold below 0.05 m/s, but release immediately on traction, stale/invalid/rejected inputs, excessive skew or violation of the unchanged model stop guard. Held samples sustain a confirmed stop but never count as new confirmations. Pair evidence must remain consecutive and expire after max_age_s. Separate state from recovery/adaptation; reset clears all stop history.
runtime_constraints: Only current/past controller/front/rear; no GNSS/IMU; unchanged 20 Hz Timeline, timestamps and zero alignment delay; O(1) stop memory. Physics, adaptation, model/recovery gates and integration remain unchanged.
prior_failures: v5 process-noise x4 increased false stops and fault RMSE; v6 projection/decay candidates failed fault-regression limits. Do not loosen the model stop guard, correction gates or acceptance criteria.
development: Use only frozen development membership, or train via its existing wheel-only loader. A development-only loader may expose the same vehicle and GNSS-speed reference topics as the validation loader, with membership and SHA256 checks before read-only SQLite IO. No train GNSS. Run the one fixed candidate; no retuning or alternate candidate after observing measurements.
freeze: Before any new validation payload is read, commit FREEZE.json with candidate source/config/evaluator hashes and development result provenance. If development shows a safety/coverage/causality regression, reject and do not run validation. Absence of reference is insufficient evidence, not zero error.
evaluator: Unmodified tools/finalization/evaluate.py score/replay/metrics and tools/research_v6/compare.py aggregation. Bind exact frozen baseline Observer and candidate Observer through a type-dispatch factory only; do not change evaluator metric functions. Same arrays, stamps, masks, both GNSS receivers and deterministic v6 fault windows. Verify evaluator/split/config hashes against the baseline commit.
fault_scenarios: Exact v6 anchor selection: first valid grid point with mean wheels >2 m/s, t>max(25 s, 0.1*bag duration), t<duration-25 s. front +5 m/s bias 5 s, both dropout 5/10 s, both zero-lock 3 s; same context and scoring windows.
additional_H09_diagnostics_not_replaceme: Per receiver: count STOPPED outputs where matched GNSS speed is >0.07 and <=0.50 m/s, and >0.50 and <=1.00 m/s; no increases per bag/receiver permitted. Report accumulated absolute odometry increments on contiguous >=1 s reference-low-speed spans (matched speed <=0.03 m/s); these are reference proxies, not certified true-stop labels. Report span coverage, entry/departure behavior and numerical speed/distance regressions. Require evidence of lower stop-distance proxy to support H09, not merely a common RMSE improvement.
falsification: Reject this one candidate for any common safety/regression violation or added low-speed STOPPED samples. Reject promotion when neither common RMSE gain target is reached. Missing data, missing independent low-speed truth or unrun validation means insufficient evidence, not confirmed improvement. No further parameter search in this round.
limitations: Wheel-only common-mode zero at low speed can be observationally indistinguishable from a true stop; the proposed history cannot prove otherwise. Reused validation is not an independent final test. Historical final-test payloads/results will not be used for selection or claimed as candidate results.
publication: Preserve plan, source hashes, commands, raw/per-bag/aggregate results, rejected result and limitations in H09-specific paths. Draft PR in Russian; no merge, auto-merge, main write or changes to others' branches or published reports. Checkpoints, if used, have H09/run_id/run_attempt names.
